# Cecep Mustafa: judicial open data and AI research

> Cecep Mustafa (ORCID 0000-0003-0037-497X, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0037-497X) builds reproducible, source-checked open datasets and AI tools on the Indonesian judiciary, with the Indonesian Judicial College (IJC).

Author: Cecep Mustafa
Affiliation: Indonesian Judicial College (IJC)
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0037-497X
GitHub: https://github.com/bsdkijc-dev
Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/judicialcollege
Licences: data CC BY 4.0; code MIT

## How to cite

Datasets: Mustafa, C. (2026). <Dataset title> [Data set]. Kaggle. <dataset URL>
Code: Mustafa, C. (2026). <Repository title> [Computer software]. GitHub. <repository URL>
Each GitHub repository has a CITATION.cff file with the full citation.

## Datasets (Kaggle, CC BY 4.0)

- [Indonesia Master Court Registry 2026](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/indonesia-master-court-registry-2026)
- [Indonesian Court Transparency Scorecard](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/indonesian-court-transparency-scorecard)
- [Mahkamah Agung RI Financial Reconciliation FY2023](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/mahkamah-agung-ri-financial-reconciliation-2023)
- [Mahkamah Agung RI Financial Reconciliation FY2024](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/mahkamah-agung-ri-financial-reconciliation-2024)
- [Mahkamah Agung RI Financial Reconciliation FY2025](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/mahkamah-agung-ri-financial-reconciliation-2025)
- [JPAIS Judicial Corpus (pilot legal ontology)](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/jpais-judicial-corpus)
- [IJC Four-Mode Judicial Knowledge Management System](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/ijc-judicial-knowledge)

## Knowledge base (CC BY-SA 4.0)

[Judicial Knowledge Hub](https://bsdkijc-dev.github.io/judicial-knowledge-hub/): 2,004 articles by Cecep Mustafa (IJC) on judicial policy, judicial education, legal AI and Indonesian Supreme Court precedents; one page per article with citation data, plus its own llms.txt. Cite as: Mustafa, C. (2026). Judicial Knowledge Hub [Wiki export]. Indonesian Judicial College (IJC). https://bsdkijc-dev.github.io/judicial-knowledge-hub/

Also on [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/judicialcollege/judicial-knowledge-hub-wiki-export-cecep-mustafa), [GitHub](https://github.com/bsdkijc-dev/judicial-knowledge-hub) and the [wiki](https://judicialknowledge.miraheze.org/wiki/Main_Page).
